principles.title: Microservices First
principles.description: Break systems into independently deployable services for scalability and maintainability

principles.title: Event-Driven Design
principles.description: Use events to decouple services and enable real-time data flow

principles.title: CQRS Pattern
principles.description: Separate read and write models for better scalability

principles.title: Infrastructure as Code
principles.description: Define all infrastructure in version-controlled code for reproducibility

principles.title: Multi-Region Deployment
principles.description: Deploy across multiple regions for high availability and disaster recovery

principles.title: Cost Optimization
principles.description: Monitor and optimize cloud spending through reserved instances and rightsizing

principles.title: Principle of Least Privilege
principles.description: Grant minimal necessary permissions to reduce attack surface

principles.title: Defense in Depth
principles.description: Implement multiple layers of security controls

principles.title: Zero Trust Architecture
principles.description: Never trust, always verify every access request

principles.title: API Versioning
principles.description: Version APIs explicitly to support multiple client versions

principles.title: Database Optimization
principles.description: Use indexes, caching, and query optimization for performance

principles.title: Stateless Services
principles.description: Design services to be stateless for horizontal scaling

principles.title: Continuous Deployment
principles.description: Automate testing and deployment to ship small changes frequently

principles.title: Observable Systems
principles.description: Implement comprehensive logging, metrics, and tracing

principles.title: Incident Response
principles.description: Establish clear runbooks and escalation procedures for incidents

principles.title: Code Review Culture
principles.description: Require peer review for all changes to ensure quality

principles.title: Test-Driven Development
principles.description: Write tests before code to ensure coverage and design

principles.title: Continuous Learning
principles.description: Invest time in learning new technologies and best practices
